english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to complete certificate of opinion regarding termination
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), where a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), was undergoing a termination of pregnancy, failed to ensure that a certificate of opinion had been completed and included in the service user's medical record
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(3) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
registered person
failed to ensure
a certificate of opinion
in respect of a service user
was completed AND
included within their medical record
when undergoing a termination of pregnancy

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Regulation 20(1) states the offence only applies to a registered person who is not an English NHS body.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant was a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), where a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), was undergoing a termination of pregnancy, failed to ensure that a certificate of opinion had been completed and included in the service user's medical record.
